analysis.title: Honeywell Aerospace Inc (HONA): Turnaround efforts may need time; Neutral
key_insights: GS stays Neutral on HONA after 3Q26. Revenue and adjusted EBIT beat consensus, but top-line growth is slow and margins are under pressure as the company reinvests and works through supply chain constraints.
3Q26 revenue was $4.64bn vs consensus $4.57bn. Adjusted EBIT was $1.16bn vs consensus $1.06bn. Free cash flow was $500mn vs consensus $413mn.
Organic revenue grew 2% y/y in 3Q26. Commercial OE rose 8% organically, commercial aftermarket 2% and Defense & Space 1%.

Supplier output is expected to build from 4Q26 through 2027, but production at constrained suppliers remains below the level HONA needs. GS says better growth and margins could be several quarters away.

FY26 guidance midpoints for EBIT and free cash flow were maintained. Pro forma standalone adjusted EBIT guidance is $4.375-$4.425bn (prior $4.35-$4.45bn) and adjusted EPS guidance is $7.85-$8.00 (prior $7.60-$7.90).
GS cut its 12-month price target to $180 from $190, based on 14.0x 2027E EV/EBITDA (15.0x prior), citing estimate revisions and a mark-to-market vs peers. Implied upside from $154.15 is 16.8%.
GS raised its FY26 EPS estimate to $7.91 from $7.69 and cut its FY27 estimate to $8.22 from $8.54 and FY28 to $9.52 from $9.95.
By segment, Electronic Solutions margin was 31.6% vs GS 28.8%, while Engines & Power Systems margin was 16.5% vs GS 19.7%, down 370bp y/y.
Adjusted EPS of $2.21 was $0.02 below GS's $2.23 estimate despite the revenue and EBIT beat.
HONA stock is down 24.6% over 3 months and 26.0% relative to the S&P 500.

market_movers.rationale: GS cut the target to $180 from $190 on a lower 14.0x 2027E EV/EBITDA multiple, reflecting estimate revisions and a mark-to-market vs peers. Neutral rating kept.

sector_views.rationale: Supply constraints limit commercial OE and aftermarket growth at HONA, and Defense & Space growth was 1% in 3Q26.
